# AI Editor migration inventory

Generated by `node tools/build-editor-inventory.cjs`. Each row identifies an actual declaration and its destination. An indexed implementation does not mean that every UI path, provider model, or deployed service has passed acceptance.

Indexed 233 source modules, 30 workspace files, and 3881 workspaces, operations, nested actions, assistant tools, configuration fields, and saved preferences.

Machine-readable details: [ai-editor-inventory.json](ai-editor-inventory.json). Provenance: [ai-editor-source-manifest.json](ai-editor-source-manifest.json). Actual checks and remaining work: [ai-editor-integration.md](ai-editor-integration.md).

## Exclusions and upstream placeholders

- Payment/checkout/subscription screens and restrictions
- Electron root and desktop shell
- Midjourney/native agent login automation
- Upstream World Labs world-mesh conversion is unavailable
- Upstream remote mastering placeholder is replaced only where the working local backend processors apply
